1 أَدَّتَّةُ دَاهِيَةٌ , aor
اَدُ3َ (T, S; M, K) and
اَدِ3َ , (M, K,) but this latter is strange, [anomalous,] and unknown, (TA,) and
اَدَ3َ , (M, K,) mentioned by Lh, whence it seems that he made the pret. to be of the measure فَعِلَ, or that it is co-ordinate to أَبَى, aor يَأْبَى, (M,) inf. n. أَدُّ, (T, S, M,) A calamity befell him. (M, K.) And in like manner, أَدَّهُ أَمْرٌ, aor. and inf. n. as above, An event befell him: (M:) or oppressed him, distressed him, or afflicted him. (Bd in xix. 91.) ＝
-A2- See also 5.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
